description: Use this when the person has decided to withdraw a case and stop it. Input: the case `id` and `confirmedByPerson`. A live case with an attorney already engaged goes on hold instead and is withdrawn once the attorney has confirmed that all work has stopped. With a live key this acts on a real case. Confirm with the person first, then pass `confirmedByPerson: true`. Do not use this to report that the tenant has paid or to ask a question (use evictions_send_case_message). The result is the case, with `state` and `nextAction` (who it is waiting on and for what). Needs the person’s account: sign-in or an API key.

confirmedByPerson.description: Set to true only after the person has said yes to this exact action on this case, in this conversation.

id.description: The case id (case_...), as returned by evictions_create_case or evictions_list_cases.

name: evictions_withdraw_case
title: Withdraw a case
